name: RAMSSOL
recent: Ramssol 近期完成多项凭单转换并发行新股，同时与 Linear Channel 签署总值 RM23m 的 AI 与设备服务协议。公司亦宣布与 Pay Day 合作，并预期 Rider Gate 业务可能受惠于 JPJ 系统调整。最新季度营收与净利均录得同比增长。
notable: 与 Linear Channel 签署总值 RM23m 的 AI 与设备服务协议。
宣布与 Pay Day 合作，可能带来经常性收入。
完成多批凭单转换并发行新股。
risks: 大股东 Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd 多次申报权益变动。
董事经理 Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng 在公开市场增持股份。
凭单持续转换导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 MYR27.28m，环比增长22.9%，同比增长50.6%；净利为 MYR7.429m，环比增长14.3%，同比增长27.2%；净利率为27.2%，低于上一季度的29.3%。

recent_en: Ramssol recently completed several warrant conversions and issued new shares, while signing RM23m agreements with Linear Channel for AI and device services. The company also announced a partnership with Pay Day and expects its Rider Gate business may benefit from JPJ system changes. Latest quarterly revenue and net profit both grew year-on-year.
notable_en: Signed RM23m agreements with Linear Channel for AI and device services.
Announced partnership with Pay Day, potentially bringing recurring income.
Completed multiple batches of warrant conversions and issued new shares.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd reported multiple changes in interest.
Managing Director Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng acquired shares in the open market.
Ongoing warrant conversions gradually enlarge the share base.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR27.28m, up 22.9% QoQ and 50.6% YoY; net profit was MYR7.429m, up 14.3% QoQ and 27.2% YoY; net margin was 27.2%, lower than 29.3% in the previous quarter.
